hhc-task-classification.activation: multi-step, multi-domain, risky, ambiguous or dependency-heavy task

hhc-repository-analysis.activation: relationship/test surface spans multiple areas or narrow discovery is insufficient

hhc-implementation-planning.activation: architecture, contract, schema, migration or multi-file dependency plan

hhc-test-strategy.activation: minimum sufficient deterministic verification is not obvious

hhc-code-review.activation: material diff needs independent semantic review

hhc-regression-review.activation: neighboring behavior or consumers may regress

hhc-accessibility-review.activation: keyboard, focus, semantics, labels, contrast or assistive access may change

hhc-release-guardrails.activation: version, tag, package, publish or release task

hhc-debugging-root-cause.activation: symptom is known but root cause is uncertain, intermittent or cross-layer

hhc-api-contract-review.activation: public/internal API, event, schema or compatibility contract changes

hhc-database-migration.activation: schema, migration, backfill, transaction or data-integrity change

hhc-dependency-change.activation: dependency add/upgrade/remove, lockfile or supply-chain impact

hhc-performance-analysis.activation: measured or plausible material latency, memory, throughput or hot-path regression

hhc-ci-build-recovery.activation: CI/build pipeline fails or differs from local verification
